steps.code:
# Build a mapping of song_id to duration from downloaded songs
downloaded_durations = {song['song_id']: song['duration'] for song in downloaded_songs}

# Define playlists from history (id, title, song_ids)
playlists = [
    (437, "Backyard Jamboree: Country Hits", [23, 31, 79, 155, 252]),
    (438, "Sweater Weather: Cozy Acoustic Tunes", [80, 100, 180, 185, 186, 243]),
    (439, "Ethereal Escapes: Ambient Grooves", [2, 56, 81, 86, 129, 132]),
    (440, "Disco Inferno: Feverish Beats", [14, 25, 28, 120, 166, 204, 284, 318, 319]),
    (441, "Classical Cornerstones", [55, 67, 79, 155, 221, 240, 304]),
    (442, "Countryside Chronicles: Folk Favorites", [9, 28, 76, 98, 104, 179, 213, 223, 260])
]

# Compute total downloaded duration for each playlist
for pid, title, song_ids in playlists:
    total = 0
    downloaded_count = 0
    for sid in song_ids:
        if sid in downloaded_durations:
            total += downloaded_durations[sid]
            downloaded_count += 1
    print(f"Playlist {pid} ({title}): downloaded songs = {downloaded_count}, total duration = {total} seconds")
    if total >= 1800:
        print("  -> This playlist has enough downloaded songs for a 30-minute walk!")
